title: Nephrology Fellowship
inst: University of Arizona College of Medicine – Tucson
Department: Division of Nephrology, Department of Medicine
Duration: 2 years (optional third year for clinical/translational research or intervention)
Eligibility: Completion of internal medicine residency; Step 3 highly recommended before applying
International applicants: Graduates of foreign medical schools welcome with a standard ECFMG certificate and an Arizona postgraduate training permit
Application method: ERAS (programme listed as participating in the AAMC ERAS Nephrology fellowship list)
Visa support: US citizenship, valid US residency or J-1 visa required; H-1B supported case by case
Summary: Two-year ACGME-accredited clinical nephrology fellowship at the University of Arizona, Tucson, training fellows since 1976 with an optional third research or interventional year.

title: Nephrology Fellowship
inst: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS) College of Medicine
Department: Division of Nephrology, Department of Internal Medicine
Application method: ERAS
Summary: ACGME-accredited two-year nephrology fellowship at UAMS with exposure to clinical, basic science, outcome and translational research, CKD, dialysis and solid organ transplantation.

title: Nephrology Fellowship (Los Angeles Medical Center / Cedars-Sinai)
inst: Kaiser Permanente Southern California – Los Angeles Medical Center

Summary: Combined Kaiser Permanente Los Angeles Medical Center/Cedars-Sinai nephrology training programme giving balanced hospital and outpatient nephrology exposure in an integrated health system and a private-practice hospital.

title: Nephrology Fellowship
inst: UC Davis Health
Department: Division of Nephrology, Department of Internal Medicine
Eligibility: Good standing in or completion of an ACGME, AOA/AACOM or equivalent internal medicine residency; USMLE Steps 1-3 (or COMLEX)

Visa support: UC Davis GME sponsors J-1 visas; currently not sponsoring H-1B visas or other visa transfers
Licence requirement: Ability to obtain a California medical licence
Summary: ACGME-accredited two-year UC Davis nephrology fellowship with extensive home dialysis, an active kidney transplant service and an ASDIN-accredited interventional nephrology programme.

title: Nephrology Fellowship
inst: Kaiser Permanente Northern California – San Francisco
